thread:
maya: Quick sync — I put together an "operational acceptance matrix" draft for GA. Need to triage gaps and owners today. High level: SLAs, docs, support rota, monitoring, pricing.

alex: can you drop the doc link? i'll scan the infra/latency bits.

maya: https://redwood.internal/ops/operational-acceptance-matrix (proto, not public) — table at the top. Key open rows: SLA wording, p95 latency target, rollback policy, who owns post-GA support, synthetic checks, pricing tier definitions.

ravi: quick notes from infra: p95 <200ms for text-generation on hosted is achievable with dedicated pools but we need autoscale + warm pool to hit it under spikes. Also KV-cache priming matters for cold-starts.

jules: support perspective — we need a runbook and a one-page escalation flow. Who's the first responder for model regressions? product or ml?

tara: suggest SRE owns infra incidents, product/ML owns model quality regressions. Support page should list the triage checklist and contact tags.

alex: agree with ravi — add a capacity requirement row: "warm-pool size" + "cold-start SLA budget". I'll add numbers after I run perf sim this afternoon.

maya: adding owners: infra -> alex, SRE -> ravi, support docs -> jules, pricing -> tara, rollout playbook -> maya. Can we commit to owners?

jules: ok for docs. I'll stub the public-runbook + internal playbook. Need sample alert messages and a sample escalation pager.

ravi: for monitoring, we need these alerts: 1) model-latency-p95 breach 2) error-rate spike (>0.5% 5m) 3) token-cost anomaly (+30% daily) 4) model-quality drift (eval set delta). Are we keeping model-quality out of infra?

maya: model-quality alert will be owned by ML team but routed to oncall. We need an integration: evals -> slack channel with measurements + thresholded alerts.

tara: pricing: current plan in draft has hosted per-token with reserved discount tiers (commit levels) + Dedicated flat monthly. Need clear mapping to SLAs and support tiers. Also define a migration/rollback credit policy for customers migrating during GA.

alex: technical rollback policy: on rollback, automatically switch traffic to previous model variant in 30s with canary cutoff. Need a documented failover matrix and a dry-run checklist.

maya: good. For SLA wording: propose "monthly uptime 99.9% for API control plane; per-model inference SLOs best-effort for free tier, guaranteed for Dedicated with X credits" — does that read ok?

tara: reword slightly: "Control plane uptime SLA: 99.9% for Dedicated + Enterprise customers; Hosted API best-effort with published latency SLOs. See support tiers for exceptions."

jules: Support hours: 24/7 for Enterprise, business hours + incident queue for self-serve. Add a contact escalation matrix with 30m initial ack for Enterprise.

ravi: synthetic checks: global probes every 1m, regional P95, and a slow-request tracer. We'll add SLO dashboards and an incident runbook link.

maya: checklist for GA gating (short):
- SLA language finalized (owner: tara)
- Public runbook + internal runbook (owner: jules)
- Oncall rotation and paging configured (owner: ravi)
- Synthetic monitoring + dashboards (owner: ravi)
- Rollback & canary documented + tested (owner: alex)
- Pricing tiers + migration credits finalized (owner: tara)
- Model-quality evals + alert thresholds (owner: alex/ml)
- Docs: Quickstart + troubleshooting + cost explorer guide (owner: jules)

alex: i'll take rollback testing and perf sims, finish by EOD.

tara: i'll push SLA and pricing text for legal review by EOD.

jules: i'll have runbooks and a one-pager for CS by tomorrow morning.

ravi: synthetic checks + oncall setup by tomorrow afternoon.

maya: thanks — final ask: can everyone add an explicit "acceptance criteria" line to the doc row they own (1-2 bullet pass/fail checks) so we can do a quick gate on Friday?

alex: will do.

jules: done — adding pass/fail for docs: publishable 1-pager + internal runbook + test alert flow.

ravi: added acceptance for monitoring: dashboards + 3 synthetic probes green for 24h.

tara: acceptance: SLA text + pricing table + legal signoff token.

maya: ok locking owners. One more: deploy-bot: status?

deploy-bot: build 9742 promoted to staging at 1727300300, smoke tests passed. No failures.

maya: great. I'll update the matrix and send an owners email after lunch. If anyone hits blockers, ping me in this thread. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — will report perf numbers here.

jules: will run through support playbook with CS tomorrow and post notes.

ravi: will run 6h stress test overnight and post results AM.

maya: end of thread — tagging owners for visibility: @alex @ravi @jules @tara.
